snapshot.what_it_does: Eternal Limited (formerly Zomato Limited) is one of the first home-grown new-age tech companies listed in India, operating through four key business segments: food delivery, quick commerce, going-out, and B2B supplies. Its platforms connect end users, restaurant partners, and delivery partners, and include the Blinkit quick-commerce platform, Hyperpure B2B supplies, and dining-out/entertainment ticketing services.

snapshot.geographies: Operations are overwhelmingly India-based; revenue from geographies outside India was INR 65 crore in FY26 (FY25: INR 51 crore), with non-current assets outside India of INR 4 crore. Subsidiaries are incorporated in India, Dubai, Ireland, and Sri Lanka.
key_facts: Consolidated total income of INR 55,760 crore in FY26 (FY25: INR 21,320 crore)
Consolidated profit for the year of INR 366 crore in FY26 (FY25: INR 527 crore); standalone profit INR 2,655 crore
Consolidated revenue from operations INR 54,364 crore (services INR 18,809 crore; goods INR 35,555 crore)
Total segment results INR 2,027 crore in FY26 (FY25: INR 1,435 crore)
No single customer represented 10% or more of total revenue in FY26

promised_vs_delivered.verdict: Where near-term claims could be checked—Blinkit margin direction, per-store NOV, working capital, NAOV stability—management delivered. Big-ticket guidance (FY29 $1bn EBITDA, District FY30, 6% margins) remains untested, and District breakeven and food-delivery growth stopped being disclosed.

rows.delivered: Consolidated EBITDA margin rose 2.3%→2.8%→2.9%→3.1% over next three quarters; Q2 FY27 reported >70% mature-city NOV EBITDA positive

bull.point: Scale compounding fast: FY26 total income INR 55,760 crore vs INR 21,320 crore FY25; Q2 FY27 revenue INR 24,138 crore, still +77.6% YoY.
Profitability inflecting: EBIT positive three straight quarters (INR 18→48→127 crore); EBITDA margin up 1.2%→3.1% in five quarters; Q2 FY27 PAT +92.3% YoY.
Near-term promises delivered: Blinkit margins expanded, NOV/store +16-17% to INR 9 lakh/day, NWC 14 days vs 18 guided; >70% mature-city NOV EBITDA positive.

bear.point: FY26 consolidated profit fell to INR 366 crore from INR 527 crore despite revenue ~2.6x; Q2 FY27 PAT margin ~0.5% (INR 125 crore on INR 24,138 crore).
Growth decelerating sharply: revenue YoY 201.9%→77.6% in four quarters; PAT (INR 92, 125 crore) still below Q4 FY26's INR 174 crore.
Food delivery's INR 2,079 crore result carries the group: Going Out lost INR 292 crore, Hyperpure earned INR 16 crore; District losses and food-delivery growth disclosure stopped.

watch: Q3 FY27 print: does Blinkit NOV growth accelerate from 79% as promised for the December quarter, with no short-term margin hit?
Whether District loss figures and food-delivery YoY growth disclosures resume, given breakeven was promised within 4-6 quarters from Q3 FY26.
Store-count trajectory vs 3,500-4,000 target (currently +~50% YoY vs 100% growth promise) and NWC path from 14 to 12 days.
